title: DocumentHeldPayload
description: Payload of the DocumentHeld event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2854 (T10). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

docsequence.description: The per-document monotonic sequence (INV-REQ-1221), duplicated in the payload alongside the envelope's own docsequence extension attribute.

prescribedPeriodRef.description: A provisional prescribed period reference: the period of the provisional transaction date built from what is known at ingestion, or the earliest candidate period where that date cannot yet be determined (FR-AE.9; added 25 Sep 2026, Keel INV-Q-1679).

postingTimestamp.description: Optional (INV-REQ-570). The time the source system posted the document, as the record request's postingTimestamp of INV-REQ-67: an ISO 8601 date-time whose offset is optional. Absent when the source gave none; never replaced by the processing date. Read by submission-svc to place the provisional register entry.

invoiceIssuedOrReceived.description: Optional (INV-REQ-570). True when a tax invoice is issued (or required) for a supply or a supplier invoice is received for a purchase; false when none exists; absent when not yet known. It is the case input of the section 10.1 table of INV-NOTE-2, read by submission-svc to place the provisional register entry. prescribedPeriodRef is unchanged.

code.description: Optional (INV-REQ-940). The error-catalogue code that opened the exception. Absent when the producer does not know it; never guessed by the consumer.

remediationOwner.description: Optional (INV-REQ-940). The effective owner of that code, as Exception.remediationOwner of console-bff/openapi.yaml. Absent when the producer does not know it; never guessed by the consumer.

disposition.description: Optional (INV-REQ-940). The base disposition of the code in the error catalogue, read as Exception.disposition of console-bff/openapi.yaml (AUTO_RELEASE, AUTO_RETRY, MANUAL, OVERRIDABLE, TERMINAL; extensible). Absent when the producer does not know it; never guessed by the consumer.
